name: Barren
description: This bug's shell becomes an Absorption score instead of Shell. Absorption decreases when taking Heart damage and can be damaged by effects that would damage Shell. If dying of starvation, becomes a Husk.

statEffects.huskTransformation: becomes Husk if dying of starvation

name: Pale Fluff
description: This bug is covered in dream-attuned fluff. After resting, regains 1 Soul (or 1 Glory Soul if exceeding max). Always knows when in presence of spirits or powerful magic.

name: Soulmates
description: Two bugs are bonded by fate intertwined. They share a Soul pool and feel an instinctive pull toward each other.
specialRequirement: must be taken by two bugs together

name: Spiral Mark
description: The bug's shell is marked by a spiral that warps magic around it. May spend 1 Soul to attempt a Soak roll against magic damage.

statEffects.magicSoak: spend 1 Soul to soak magic damage
statEffects.absorptionUsage: can use Absorption instead of Shell for soak
